pages.text: Grandpa has had lots of adventures.
He has been to Paris and has seen the Eiffel Tower.
He has ridden a camel in the desert.
He has flown in a small plane over the sea.
"Have you ever seen a whale, Grandpa?" asks Bix. "Yes, I have!"

questions.ask: What has Grandpa done in the desert?
What has he done over the sea?
